method: Two private loopback daemons from clean committed Syzygy worktrees used the registered Butlers source gate. Their first captures encountered different Beads revisions, so both private daemons re-observed concurrently through their existing human-open route. Authenticated machine metadata then matched on Butlers Git revision, working-tree digest, Dolt revision, 7624 work items and 283 project-shape sources; full evaluation identities still differ by observer commit, as expected. Final paired direct and mounted-form requests used curl --output /dev/null --write-out http_code/size_download. Mounted form sets the real tailnet Host and Origin headers while the backend receives the unprefixed route. The invalid first Node-fetch Host-override probe returned HTTP 403 and is excluded from the final measurement. No credential value, response body or Butlers content is retained here.

polarisPopulationDirectAndMounted.method: Server HTML tags and mounted exact-route href attributes counted independently of renderer functions; browser tests additionally inspect the post-script DOM, native Tab order and no-script copy. The decrease of 283 summary controls reflects removal of each per-row source-record details, not a loss of 283 source records.

machinePopulationCheck.method: Both authenticated machine bodies were parsed in process; only counts and SHA-256 over sorted claim-id occurrences and ordered source paths were emitted. Observer/evaluation-specific fields were excluded from these two population digests.

directPolarisByteAttribution.interpretation: The source table genuinely shrank after eliminating repeated per-row role attributes and field captions, while retaining its six scoped columns, every identity/tuple marker and no-body-read text. The whole Polaris response still grew by 4022 bytes because the fuller outline, seven shortcuts and subject-bearing labels are new. The pre-trim probe was a separate earlier window with a different Beads revision, so only the final re-observed pair supports the all-route same-window delta claim.

boundary: This is a bounded non-release Butlers POC measurement, not a product-completion or production-network claim. The tailnet form was simulated locally with Host/Origin; it was not an external tailnet request. Actual catalog filtering/pagination remains out of scope.
